responsibility: Core machine description for the SH backend. It defines the main RTL patterns, constants, unspec codes, attributes, expanders, peepholes, splits, assembly output templates, and instruction semantics for general SH code generation, covering arithmetic, control flow, stack manipulation, FPSCR/T-bit behavior, stack protector support, and inclusion of the separate atomic instruction descriptions from sync.md.
same_name_distinction: Provides the declarative machine description for SH instruction recognition, expansion, attributes, and asm templates, unlike sh.cc's hand-written backend logic, sh.h's preprocessor/macros and target definitions, and sh.opt's command-line option declarations.
